evidence_items.explanation: The experiment illustrates why success on familiar tasks does not establish broad generalization and why surrounding procedures matter. It does not prove that additional data and compute could never overcome the observed limits.

The study demonstrates meaningful gains from changing the allocation of model size and training data under a compute budget. It weighs against dismissing those resources, but benchmark improvement does not settle their ultimate sufficiency.

These recent results demonstrate substantial benchmark capability and must be considered alongside earlier limitations. They neither establish the full contextual goal nor identify data and compute alone as the cause.
